components.name: data-hub
components.role: The whole platform as one Compose project: backend API, React front end, Postgres with PostGIS (bronze, silver, gold, catalogue, audit), embedded Airflow with Cosmos and dbt, Airflow metadata database, MCP server, backup and heartbeat (doc 10, CMP-001 to CMP-010, CMP-019, CMP-020). Phase 2 and 3 components (CMP-011 to CMP-018) are not composed yet.

assets.use: Airflow scheduler, DAG processor and API server, local executor (CMP-006); pinned: apache-airflow[postgres]==3.4.0 with constraints-3.4.0/constraints-3.12.txt
Cosmos renders each dbt model as an Airflow task (CMP-006); pinned: astronomer-cosmos==1.16.0 under the same constraints
dbt-core in its own virtual environment in the Airflow image (CMP-005, DEC-004)
dbt-postgres adapter, in dbt's own virtual environment (CMP-005)
Official MCP Python SDK for the MCP server, in the backend image (CMP-008)

configuration.set_in: Git-ignored .env for secrets; YAML in config/ for thresholds, weights, limits, schedules and source links; example files with placeholders only
configuration.template_options: share off; theme on; help guides on; feedback on with problem, suggestion and question stored in the app; heartbeat on (D-006)

adaptations: Sample sites and surveys domain removed
Roles become consumer, owner, steward and admin; groups, named grants with expiry, personal access tokens and per-user read-only database logins added
Database migrations create the bronze, silver, gold, catalogue and audit schemas
New services in the Compose file: Airflow scheduler, DAG processor and API server (not published), Airflow metadata database, MCP server
Pipelines package (manifest validator, DAG factory, orchestrator interface, ingest, checks, profiling, scoring), dbt project and GeoPackage module added as custom code
Template features: Share off, feedback stored rather than emailed (D-006)

links.what: catalogue reads and writes; previews and exports under the user's read-only login (INT-004)
orchestrator interface: trigger runs, read run status (INT-005)
ingest to bronze, dbt silver and gold through Cosmos, run and check records (INT-006)
manifests and dbt models read by the DAG factory (INT-011)
read-only SELECT under the token user's login (INT-008)

limitations: Airflow, Cosmos, dbt-core, dbt-postgres and the MCP SDK were approved on a static review and an install check; their own test suites have not run
Their combination is proven only as installs and imports in clean containers (source/samples/install-check-2026-11-14.md), not as a DAG run
dbt cannot share Airflow's environment (pathspec conflict); it runs from its own virtual environment
Spatial performance on the real flood map is unmeasured until EPIC-007
Phase 2 and 3 components (OGC API server, OData, notifications, Entra, reverse proxy, Copilot agent, lineage store) are not chosen or proven

Phase 1 connector libraries (HTTP client, Postgres and SQL Server drivers, JSON, Excel and Parquet readers; CAP-026) and the secrets store (CAP-027, Docker secrets) are not chosen, imported or approved (CR-001); needed before EPIC-019 and EPIC-023
